title: Retail Sales Analytics Dashboard
description: A complete retail analytics workflow using Python, SQL, Excel-compatible exports, and Power BI/Tableau-ready dashboard files.
problem: Business order data needs to be cleaned, modeled, and exported into formats that decision makers can review quickly.
solution: Generated a reproducible pipeline that cleans raw orders, builds SQLite tables, writes BI-ready CSV exports, creates an Excel workbook XML, and produces a dashboard preview.
impact: Shows practical data analysis delivery from raw data to dashboard assets and stakeholder-friendly reporting.

title: Customer Churn ML Forecasting
alt: Customer churn machine learning and forecasting preview
description: A data science project that creates a churn dataset, performs EDA, trains a churn model, evaluates performance, and forecasts churn volume.
problem: Retention teams need to know which customers are at risk and how much churn to expect in the next few months.
solution: Built a churn scoring workflow with feature engineering, model evaluation metrics, risk bands, and a six-month forecast output.
impact: Demonstrates machine learning, exploratory analysis, model evaluation, and forecasting in a practical business case.

title: TaskFlow Flutter Firebase App
description: A Flutter app foundation with Firebase sync, REST API loading, responsive UI layouts, Dart models, and Git-ready project structure.
problem: A strong mobile portfolio needs more than a mockup; it needs real app architecture, service layers, and responsive screens.
solution: Created a Flutter Material 3 app with Firebase repository code, REST API service code, task models, responsive layout, and setup documentation.
impact: Shows practical Flutter development skills in a project that can be configured and extended into a production app.

title: Student Performance Research Study
description: A research-style analysis of UCI student performance data using descriptive statistics, inference, hypothesis testing, regression, probability, and research methods.
problem: Student achievement data needs careful analysis to identify reliable academic signals without overclaiming causality.
solution: Downloaded the public UCI dataset, summarized key variables, built bootstrap intervals, tested internet-access group differences, modeled final grades, and reported conditional probabilities.
impact: Shows a complete statistics workflow from research question to reproducible report and portfolio-ready charts.

title: Auto MPG Regression Analysis
alt: Vehicle weight versus MPG regression chart
description: A fuel-efficiency study using UCI Auto MPG data to explain MPG with vehicle specifications, model year, and origin.
problem: Historical vehicle data contains overlapping signals, making it important to separate descriptive patterns from modeled associations.
solution: Prepared the dataset, handled missing horsepower values, compared origin groups with a permutation test, and built an interpretable multiple regression model.
impact: Demonstrates regression interpretation, conditional probability, and careful statistical reporting on a familiar real-world dataset.

title: BAC Probability Experiment
alt: Beers consumed versus blood alcohol content regression chart
description: A compact experimental-data project using OpenIntro BAC data for probability, hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, and regression.
problem: Small experimental samples need transparent uncertainty estimates and careful interpretation.
solution: Used bootstrap intervals, a one-sided permutation test, empirical probabilities, and simple regression to explain the beer-to-BAC relationship.
impact: Highlights research design, random assignment context, and responsible statistical conclusions for a small sample.

title: Insight Dashboard
description: A dashboard concept focused on turning business data into fast, readable performance insights.
problem: Decision makers need a clear view of trends, comparisons, and key metrics without reading long reports.
solution: Designed a structured analytics workflow with cleaned data, KPI cards, trend visuals, and simple filtering.
impact: Makes patterns easier to understand and supports quicker evidence-based decisions.

title: Flutter Mobile App Concept
description: A mobile app concept built around responsive screens, smooth navigation, and a polished user interface.
problem: Mobile users need a clean app experience that feels fast, readable, and consistent across screen sizes.
solution: Structured reusable Flutter widgets, responsive layouts, and simple flows for a professional mobile interface.
impact: Improves usability and creates a strong base for a production-ready app experience.
